summary: Operator explicitly authorized the v1.0.3 self-hosted-only publication cycle across GitHub Release, PyPI and GHCR; historical releases remain unyanked.

decisions.rationale: The Operator explicitly confirmed that each external user installs their own server and authorized publishing the corrected self-hosted-only v1.0.3 artifacts through all named registries.
Preserve immutable PyPI and Git history without yanking; append a public GitHub release note that v1.0.2 is superseded by v1.0.3 after the new release is live.
